# NonStop Marketing

> NonStop Marketing delivers comprehensive web design, development, and digital marketing services for small businesses and enterprise clients.

Based in San Diego, NonStop Marketing specializes in WordPress-based website design, SEO optimization, hosting solutions, and industry-specific marketing strategies. The agency offers both one-time services and ongoing monthly packages tailored to client needs.

## Key Topics

- WordPress Development
- SEO Optimization
- Local SEO
- Website Design
- Digital Marketing
- Web Hosting
- Keyword Research
- Backlink Audit
- Small Business Solutions
- FinTech Marketing
- Restaurant Web Solutions
- WordPress Maintenance
- Paid Advertising
- Content Writing
- Lead Generation

## SEO Services

- [SEO Optimization](https://nonstopmarketing.co/product/seo-optimization): SEO Optimization product: $1200 initial audit, backlink audit, keyword research, on-page setup.
- [Local SEO Optimization](https://nonstopmarketing.co/product/local-seo-optimization): Local SEO product: $1,900 includes audit, 25 directory submissions, keyword research.
- [Ongoing Monthly (SEO) Optimization](https://nonstopmarketing.co/product/monthly-seo-optimization): Monthly SEO service with ongoing optimization, backlink audits, and external article placement.
- [SEO: Onsite Optimization](https://nonstopmarketing.co/seo-optimization): SEO optimization guide covering onsite, local SEO, keyword research, and monthly services.

## Website Design & Development

- [Website Design](https://nonstopmarketing.co/website-design): Website design services featuring WordPress, responsive design, and small business packages.
- [WordPress Developer](https://nonstopmarketing.co/wordpress-developer): San Diego WordPress developer services using Enfold Theme and Avia Layout Builder.
- [WordPress Maintenance](https://nonstopmarketing.co/wordpress-maintenance): WordPress maintenance service covering security, backups, plugin updates, and hosting support.
- [Hosting Packages](https://nonstopmarketing.co/hosting-packages): Web hosting packages with WordPress support, SSL certificates, backups, and maintenance.

## Service Packages & Solutions

- [Business Starter Package](https://nonstopmarketing.co/industry/business-starter-package): Starter package for small businesses including web design, hosting, email, and branding.
- [Custom Tailored Monthly Service](https://nonstopmarketing.co/product/monthly-service): Custom monthly service packages for web design, SEO, content writing, WordPress maintenance.
- [Restaurant Web Solutions](https://nonstopmarketing.co/industry/restaurant-web-solutions): Restaurant web design solutions using WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace with SEO focus.
- [FinTech Marketing](https://nonstopmarketing.co/industry/fintech-marketing): FinTech industry marketing services: branding, product launch, content, paid advertising.
